title.zh: 分支测试下的目标唯一性

statement.en: Where branching tests tell apart the configurations of a target frame, a configuration of any source frame passes the same branching tests as at most one target configuration; likewise for likeness.
statement.zh: 凡分支测试区分目标框架的构形，任一源框架的构形至多与一个目标构形通过相同分支测试；相同（likeness）亦然。

laws.en: A branching test is nothing, a claim, the failure of a test, two tests together, or that some step by a move leads to where a test holds; configurations of two frames pass the same branching tests where every such test holds at the one exactly where it holds at the other.
laws.zh: 分支测试是：无、一个主张、一个测试的失败、两个测试同时，或某步经某动作通往测试成立处；两个框架的构形通过相同分支测试，是指每个这样的测试在一处成立恰当在另一处成立。

laws.en: For any two frames, with no finiteness of their steps assumed: where branching tests tell apart the configurations of the target (any two passing the same branching tests are equal), a configuration of the source passes the same branching tests as at most one target configuration.
laws.zh: 对任意两个框架，不假设其步的任何有限性：凡分支测试区分目标的构形（通过相同分支测试的任两个相等），源的一个构形至多与一个目标构形通过相同分支测试。

laws.en: For any two frames: where likeness tells apart the configurations of the target (any two alike configurations of it are equal), a configuration of the source is alike to at most one target configuration.
laws.zh: 对任意两个框架：凡相同（likeness）区分目标的构形（其任两个相同的构形相等），源的一个构形至多与一个目标构形相同。

hypotheses.en: Any two frames of the spine with the same moves and claims; the target frame is separated by branching tests, or for the likeness law by likeness.
hypotheses.zh: 脊柱上任意两个有相同动作与主张的框架；目标框架被分支测试分离，相同之律中被相同分离。

does_not_show.en: Configurations passing the same branching tests need not be alike: where a move has infinitely many outcomes, two configurations can pass the same tests and not be alike.
does_not_show.zh: 通过相同分支测试的构形不必相同：某动作有无穷多结果时，两个构形可通过相同测试而不相同。

does_not_show.en: Uniqueness of the matching configuration does not make the target frame the one right description of the source.
does_not_show.zh: 匹配构形的唯一性不使目标框架成为源的唯一正确描述。

does_not_show.en: The law is for these branching tests; a richer test language must keep its own semantics, as the tests with parts do.
does_not_show.zh: 此律针对这些分支测试；更丰富的测试语言须保留其自身语义，如带部分的测试。

The periphery ExplanatoryBranching and the retired Bridge are provenance; the receipt under explanatory-branching-checks keeps its earlier scope.

next_delta.en: Give, for an application, the target frame its branching tests separate, so that each observed configuration has one matching target configuration.
next_delta.zh: 为一个应用给出其分支测试所分离的目标框架，使每个被观察的构形有唯一匹配的目标构形。

correspondence.zh: 测试包括条件、否定、合取和动作后继；测试适用性是解释范围的一部分。
correspondence.en: Tests include conditions, negation, conjunction and action successors; their applicability is part of explanatory scope.

detail.zh: 声明形似，但测试与模型不同；未断言这两个引理相互转换。
detail.en: Similar header, different tests and models; no adapter between these lemmas is asserted.

detail.zh: Alike.functional：相同分离一个框架的配置时，一个配置至多与其中一个相同；配置的同一读作相同时（AI 的读法），这就是那种同一。
detail.en: Alike.functional: where likeness tells a frame's configurations apart, a configuration is alike to at most one of them; with the identity of configurations read as likeness (an AI reading), this is that identity.
